text: This is a useful limit on any blanket statement that reliance makes a promise enforceable. Identify the governing statute and the jurisdiction’s exception before relying on § 90 in the abstract.
sourceSummary: The alleged oral promise to delay foreclosure fell within the Texas loan-agreement writing requirement, and the pleaded reliance did not satisfy the specific estoppel exception applied by the court.
basis: Synthesis of the cited assigned excerpt.
